subject: maybe its a ploy
author: drunknnumpty
body:
maybe there is some big conspiracy to get people to like Santa Ana by making the previous version comms and connections just as bad.. this way when they finally fix all the comms in Santa Ana then everyone will play it... 😛

and yes I am going to keep calling it Santa Ana as I can't bring myself to use the P word as it makes me feel like a hypocrite..

oh no.. have I said too much.. will I now be stopped from getting online tonite.. lol..

think it could be whatever maintainance they carried out and hopefully they have fixed whatever issues they were having.. fingers crossed and see you online later (hopefully)..

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...

subject: Didn't invite the Team
author: ZombieTron
body:
Oh no! We made them angry and now they wont let us play!! But, we did send them a Postcard!

From the Criterion Forums it seems like we weren't the only one with issues, I would put it down to something done in the Tuesday maintenance. The wierdest thing was that others were playing fine when we got the "game can not be played online at this time" message. Paradise, Revenge and BO3 were all affected. And when I finally did get connected to Revenge after 2 resets and testing if I could get online in Paradise, which I couldn't, I could only hear 2 other players in the room??? Kinda reminded me of the problems we normally have on Paradise!!! 😲

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Same problem here. I tried
author: The Kid 74
body:
Same problem here. I tried to connect to the server to join Burnout Paradise and it would lock up everytime. I had to sign out to my dashboard and start the game all over again. Hopefully it is back up and running again. Any word on the big announcement yet. Maybe they will be adding something awesome. One thing I would like to see is a customizable car, but only if you have your elite license.

 

Happy smashing
